2014_spells.wall-of-water.description: You conjure up a wall of water on the ground at a point you can see within range. You can make the wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or you can make a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick.
2014_spells.wall-of-water.effectSummary: Summon a creature to fight for you for the duration
2014_spells.wall-of-water.fullDescriptio: Using 1 action, you conjure up a wall of water on the ground at a point you can see within range. You can make the wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or you can make a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The effect lasts for concentration, up to 10 minutes.
